create_model: create a CLIP model from a config name with optional pretrained weights and precision settings
create_model_and_transforms: create a CLIP model along with train and validation image preprocessing transforms
create_model_from_pretrained: create a CLIP model loaded from pretrained weights with an optional image preprocessing transform
list_models: list all available CLIP model architecture names registered from config files
load_checkpoint: load a PyTorch checkpoint state dict into a CLIP model with automatic key compatibility fixes
